title: Concept: Overly broad file permissions (c) — review required
description: In c, [^0-9A-Za-z]0777 sets permission bits that include world access. Broad modes on code, keys, or data turn any local account into a writer or reader. The remedy is least-privilege modes via 0644/0755 least privilege.
applicability: c code and scripts setting file modes; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Local tampering or disclosure; MEDIUM severity, HIGH for executables, keys, and configuration.
